what: When the section reaches 70% of the screen, two background-color curtains on both sides part from the center outward in 1s, and the title letters resolve from a 10px blur and 15% below in a .04 stagger over .6s. When the section head reaches the top of the screen the section pins, and while scrolling (band width − screen width) × 2, the wide aerial photo band and the label layer above it (A·B labels) travel horizontally together. Cloud layers are each pushed 10, 20 and 30% more in left so they drift at different speeds, and the title is also pushed 10%. At progress .3 the title letters shrink to .7 scale while blurring and disappear in a .04 stagger (all power1.inOut, tied to scroll).

options.ratio: Fixed Length = (band width − screen width) × ratio, default 2
options.fade: Progress point where title letters start to scatter, default .3
options.ease: Curve (GSAP name or 0.65,0,0.35,1 form), default power1.inOut

use:
A·B labelCloud

Title
note: The strip is height 100% · width auto so it widens with the photo ratio. The display layer stretches to the strip width and moves with the strip. Below 1120px only progress .15~.85 passes, below 600px only .22~.78. Uses SplitText if present, otherwise splits letters by hand

from.where: index.html horizontal section #Horizontal — original pin end +=2×(scrollWidth − innerWidth), cloud left −=10·20·30%, title left −=10%, letters at .3 from opacity 0·scale .7·blur 10 stagger .04 .4s, curtain width 0 1s, all power1.inOut
